L3·N3642unmasked layer
Fires on mid-word continuation subword pieces that complete rare capitalized acronyms/brand names (LSE→"SE", LVO→"VO", VKAC→"VK", Bextor→"or") as well as garbled mojibake/Cyrillic fragments; it is strongly suppressed on a very similar class of acronym-completion tokens (DRI, KNURE, RFEF, PRC), so it's a surface-form/token-identity detector rather than a semantic one.

L3·N5677unmasked layer

L3·N10133unmasked layer
This neuron is mainly a *negative* detector: it is strongly suppressed by the first sub-token of a proper surname following a personal first name (e.g. "Cis|neros", "Hag|strom", "Sab|re", "Pad|gett"), while it fires only weakly-positively on word-initial pieces of ordinary content words in promotional/list-style copy ("Good", "craz|ier", "POSIT|IVES", "torrents", "Parties", "Volley|ball").
